caption:
Creamy Garlic Pasta 🍝

This is my go-to weeknight dinner, SAVE IT!

Ingredients:
• 8 oz spaghetti
• 3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1/2 cup parmesan
• 1 cup heavy cream
• salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Boil the pasta until al dente.
2. Sauté garlic in butter for 1 minute.
3. Add cream and parmesan, then toss with pasta.

#pasta #dinner #easyrecipes
title: Creamy Garlic Pasta

caption:
the easiest banana bread ever 🍌
3 ripe bananas, 1/3 cup melted butter, 3/4 cup sugar, 1 egg, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 1/2 cups flour
1) mash bananas and mix in butter
2) stir in sugar, egg and baking soda
3) fold in flour and bake at 350F for 60 minutes

caption:
Chicken tikka bowls

For the chicken:
- 500g chicken thighs
- 150g yoghurt
- 2 tsp garam masala

For the rice:
- 200g basmati
- 400ml water

Method
1. Marinate the chicken in yoghurt and spices for 1 hour.
2. Grill until charred.
3. Simmer rice in water for 12 minutes.
4. Serve together.
title: Chicken tikka bowls

caption:
Crispy sesame tofu bowls 🥢

Honestly the best thing I've made all month, you HAVE to try it.

Recipe

Crispy tofu
Toss your tofu cubes in cornstarch, salt and pepper. Air fry at 400F for 15min shaking halfway.

Sesame glaze
In a pan add
2 tbsp sesame oil
3 tbsp maple syrup
1/4 cup of soy sauce
2 garlic cloves minced
1 tsp chili flakes
Simmer until thick, then toss the tofu in it.

Quick slaw
Shred cabbage and carrot, add 2 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar. Serve everything over rice.
title: Crispy sesame tofu bowls
